notes.title: 0.2.7 - Eggcellent Update
notes.notes:
Easter is here!
*ahem*
Easter [i]was[/i] here!
[h2]Introducing Isle's first (belated) Seasonal Event![/h2]
Our resident artist, in a burst of inspiration, concocted an absolutely majestic Easter costume one evening. Refusing to let such a vivid masterpiece go to waste, I suddenly realized it was necessary to implement a small event and an entire Layered Armor system to accommodate.
This update also includes a couple new features that were ready enough to be pushed alongside the event, including the oft-requested Equipment Sets! New story content is in the works and coming along nicely, but wasn't at the level of polish/balance I wanted it to be at to make in time for this update. However, it should be on its way soon~

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Become the egg![/b] Eggs have started appearing around the Isles, and only you seem to have noticed. Collect 8 different eggs from across the locales and various systems, and the "Tercet Best" layered armor is yours to keep! It offers no stat benefits, but can visually appear above any armor you choose to wear! The event runs until May 5th, at which point all the eggs will vanish as mysteriously as they came.
[*][b]Equipment Sets![/b] Swap hunters between entire sets of Armor/Weapons at the touch of a button! Once unlocked through Village Construction, you will be able to create 2 separate Equipment loadouts and quickly switch your Hunters between them whenever desired. No more unoptimized gathering because it was too much a pain to swap back and forth (hopefully)! More equipment sets will be unlocked with future updates.
[*][b]Achievements![/b] This has been in the cards for a long while, and the bones of it are finally here! Unlock 12 achievements, and bask in the completion number going up! Currently very early in its implementation, but it's robust enough that Steam Achievements should finally be coming with the next content update!
[/list]

[u]Full patch notes:[/u]
04/23/25 - 0.2.7 - Eggcellent Update
NEW CONTENT:
- Achievements! Very WIP atm, suggestions appreciated. Found in the old 'Objectives Log' book button (Steam Achievements on the way)
- Easter Event! Collect Eggs to get purely cosmetic layered armor!
- And with that, a layered armor system! Currently only supports the new Easter set, but will be expanded upon with newer sets
NEW QOL:
- Equipment Sets! Available after building the Longhouse. Swap between hunter Equipment loadouts at the touch of a button
- Steam Cloud Saves can now be loaded from the main-menu
- Hunter HP Bars are always visible on the Quest page if below max health
CHANGES:
- Diary/Objective log entirely overhauled
- Hunters' equip boxes change color to show which item you're hovering over
- Expeditions now allow auto-return when all tools are broken
- The 5th Hunter now canonically moves into the Longhouse (shown in the construction tab)
- Finally added the remaining missing weapon icon textures
FIXES:
- Fixed a potential bug when dragging a hunter into the Quest/Boat slot they were already in
- Refinery no longer shows lower odds if no items are in the Input
- Locale highlights on the Expeditions map no longer carry over when switching Isles
- Cleaned up some subtle armor visual layering issues

notes.title: Roadmap + Browser Compatibility Update!
notes.notes:
The game has been out  just over 1 week, and managed to get around 200+ players in it's first 7 days! This has exceeded my expectations for my little passion project, so thank you for everyone who tried it out, and to the people who left reviews! Reviews go a massive way towards making the game more visible on Steam, plus I just appreciate the feedback!

That being said, there's a lot coming up! I work a full-time job but my evenings are committed to making this game everything I want it to be, and I am determined to push out a notable update every 2 weeks, with laid-out goals for each month formed by the community. The two big ones: [b]Steam Achievements and Stick/Early-game rebalancing[/b]! Expect the rebalancing in the next couple of days, and Achievements within the month! I heard your (very justified) cries about drop-rates and break chances and am determined to get them into a smoother state.

Further news for people without a Windows device: [b]The full game is now fully playable in-browser[/b]! If you have a Mac or otherwise incompatible device with the offline build, the website now supports logging in with your Steam account (through Valve's secure servers), and if your account owns the game you'll be able to play it fully online! Otherwise, the website will allow you to play a full demo of the game, which covers around the first 8 hours(!!) of content! The web build is the same as the offline build with a few parameters changed, and will therefore be up-to-date with the offline build whenever something new comes out. ([b]Offline demo is currently in review, and will be up on Steam as soon as possible[/b])

[url=https://www.lonelyfrontier.com/Isles/]Link to the website here![/url]

Thank you for a fantastic launch, and I'm incredibly excited to show you all what I've been working on for the future content. There's a lot planned, and I'm determined to build onto this game until it surpasses my current vision!

And without further ado, the first Roadmap:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068279/131704d23eaff6954e41e6a850443ebe683ca818.jpg[/img]

[b]The roadmap will be kept up to date on the Steam Store page, as well as through the occasional announcment.[/b]
It's also a good time to you to export/download your saves every once in a while, just in case anything goes awry. Will be adding incentives to the menu soon.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43828/the_Lonely_Frontier_Complete_Story/]There is also now a bundle, in case you want to check out the other game I put out on Steam for a discounted price![/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43828/the_Lonely_Frontier_Complete_Story/

As always, if you have any thoughts, please let me know in any of the usual places or as a comment below!
